customManagers.description: The dated OSS CAD Suite build and the tarball's SHA-256. The release tags are dates (2026-11-05), and the attachment digest is the linux-x64 tarball hash, so github-release-attachments updates the date and the checksum in ONE update; the PR build then re-runs the version gate and the smoke regression.

packageRules.description: Monthly suite bump (14-day release-age floor, never automerged): it changes every tool the image inherits from the suite (Icarus, SymbiYosys, GHDL, GTKWave), and the checksum moves with the date. The PR is a prompt to read the rebuild and the smoke result.
